Title: Implement splitbrain_document_code tool (generate inline documentation)
Description: Generate inline documentation for code: XML doc comments for C#, JSDoc for TypeScript/JavaScript, Python docstrings, Javadoc for Java. Completely mechanical and tedious for a developer; ideal for an LLM. Natural complement to refactor_code — after refactoring, you want documentation. Routes to Quality node (documentation quality matters). Parameters: code, language, style (xml|jsdoc|docstring|javadoc), includeExamples?
